newsitem.title: USA: Palomar Medical settles Commonwealth case.
newsitem.headline: Palomar Medical settles Commonwealth case.

text.p: Palomar Medical Technologies Inc said Monday that it has settled its case with Commonwealth Associates for $1.875 million, which means Palomar will be reimbursed over $1.6 million of a $3.5 million bond it posted to appeal an earlier ruling.

In January a federal district court in New York granted Commonwealth Associates' motion for partial summary judgment as to liability, and in June, awarded it $3.17 million in its breach of contract case against Palomar, said the company.
At issue, said the company, was whether Commonwealth had fulfilled its obligations, under an agreement, to act as Palomar's financial advisor.
Last month, Palomar began the appeal process by posting a $3.5 million bond, and this settlement ends the case.
Palomar is a supplier of proprietary laser systems for dermatological and cosmetic laser treatments.
